race.description: Murray Bridge Gold Cup - Book Now Hcp (Bm56)
race.comment: TAUPO TIGER (8) has recently joined the Stokes team, and he ran the race of an improver when finishing third here 3 weeks ago over 2000m. He cops another wide draw, but is good enough to take this out, especially if the ground is testing. YOROKOBI (5) won his penultimate start at Mackay before joining the Weinert stable at Strathalbyn, and finishing fourth less then a length from the winner as the favourite. He has less time between runs this time and should go close to taking this out. Follow your money. TOTTORI (3) has found it hard to win another race, but he will find this easier than any of his last 3 starts. He has the pole position and is worth including in all combos. CHANCE TAKEN (9) made up a lot of late ground at Morphettville 4 days ago, and he is expected to be competitive in this. Each-way value. EXALTED FIRE (1) is a durable veteran, and at this level, he is always an each-way threat.
